BrochureContent.Content:
Patricia Stokes Auctioneers & Valuers are delighted to present to the market 41 Aylesbury a spacious light filled three bedroomed home in a superb location. When launched to the market the new development of Aylesbury tag line was ?Appreciation for Living? followed with ?a fantastic opportunity to purchase a truly special home in a highly sought-after location. Built to the highest specification with a host of energy efficiency features from underfloor heating, heat recovery system and Daikin air to water system it is easy to see why this home returns an A2 energy rating. Finished in St Ives cream rustica brick complimented by a smooth plaster painted in a pleasing colour trend scheme along with some punches out zinc elements this home is appealing from the off. 
The property has been owner occupied since its purchase in 2020 and has been exceptionally well cared for over its short life. Rooms are bright and spacious and all bedrooms are double in size. The property extends to an impressive 1,525 sq. ft. approx. The owner spared no expense in the quality of fittings from kitchen to sanitary ware and robes to tiling. The accommodation in brief offers and inviting entrance hall, open plan kitchen cum dining room, extensive lounge, utility room and guest bathroom. The top floor enjoys three double bedrooms with main bedroom en-suite and a family bathroom. The property is fitted with air to water heating giving comfort underfoot in all reception rooms with traditional radiators in the bedrooms overhead. The use of floor to ceiling deep set glazed bay window as well as glazed doors to the rear patio enhances the natural light and solar gain. A beautifully enclosed patio off the kitchen cum dining room caters for outside space and is perfect for morning coffee or evening dining. The front of the property has cobble lock drive way with ample parking set inside low wall finished in the St Ives brickwork.
The open areas within Aylesbury were well thought out at the early stages and is now beginning to pay dividends. The open greens are well tended as are the common planted areas when on the second Saturday of each month those who are available come together to tend. Grants from city council are available to communities vested in maintaining their areas and Aylesbury has taken full advantage with a shed now well stocked with all tools required. A professional designer assisted in the design of the green spaces and thousands of spring bulbs planted bring burst of colour that last through the summer months.
The location of Aylesbury is second to none nestled in the neighbourhood of Ballintemple with the parishes of Blackrock and Ballinlough on its doorstep. For those who may not be familiar with the location the amount of open green spaces, recreational activities, sporting clubs and schools are probably the most expansive Cork has to offer. The open greens range from the renowned Beaumont Park directly across the road from the scheme. This park has meandering paths and big open greens set against the backdrop of the old quarry. The Japanese Gardens with Gus Healy swimming pool along with the tennis club and community grounds at Ballinlough are all within an easy walk. The adjacent bustling village of Blackrock offers cafes as well as its popular weekly farmers market. There is leisurely recreation catered for at the 8km loop of the Blackrock greenway walking and cycling path which extends from the city to Passage . Cork city with all that it has to offer is within walking distance of this home. 
Viewing of this home is a must to appreciate all that it has to offer. 


Outside 
This home has the added benefit of its own terrace located off the open plan kitchen cum dining room. The terrace is finished with wood block flooring with pebble surround and give a lovely calming space to sit in and sip morning coffee or enjoy evening meals.

Entrance Painted front door complete with zinc finished canopy and glazed panel leads you through to a bright and welcoming reception hall. This reception is inviting with a black and white tile floor leading to the brightly painted staircase. The entrance hall enjoys double height with a high level landing window. A hint of gold is used in the light fitting.
Reception Hall (5.58ft x 7.55ft) Finished with a black slate style floor the reception hall is spacious and painted in white to bounce the natural light.
Lounge (20.01ft x 16.08ft) Located to the front of the property and looking out onto a mature green space this room is beautiful. Finished in the same black tile and painted in crisp white the impact of this room is appealing. A floor to ceiling glazed deep bay window is an ideal nook to sit in and watch the world go by. With the underfloor heating, coupled with the south facing solar gain this room is cosy and inviting any time of the year. A tucked away recess acts as a home office space depending on the purchasers' requirements. Fitted with recessed lights as well as independent light.
Kitchen/Dining Room (20.01ft x 12.47ft) Located to the rear of the property is a wonderful open plan room catering easily for both functions. The kitchen is styled and fitted by Kube renowned for bespoke designs and layouts uniquely customised for the space. It compliments and merges perfectly with the additional function of this room. The units are finished in an appealing grey matt tone with handle less surfaces and offers extensive storage at both floor and eye level. The entire kitchen is topped with a polished quartz stone worktop with upstand and grooved draining board. Appliances fitted and included in the sale are from the De Dietrich range and offer double, fridge freezer and dishwasher. The use of a Bora induction hob complete with built in extractor makes for easy cooking. A soft background of wood finish is used in the division over the counter top space and is illuminated by the lights set under the overhead units. A double bowel sink unit sits beneath a wide picture window making this room beautifully
Utility Room (4.95ft x 7.55ft) Mirroring the units fitted in the kitchen by Kube this utility room takes care of any and all overflow storage required. It offers additional counter top space finished in wood. The utility has a floor to ceiling press housing Bosch washing machine and tumble dryer. The Daikin air to water heating unit in the adjoining floor to ceiling press keeps the clear lines throughout the room. Additional storage is catered for at under counter level.
Guest WC (5.58ft x 3.94ft) Two-piece white suite fitted with close couple wc complete with soft closing. A wall hung sink with extensive vanity mirror fitted with light and finished with gold trim. Tiled floor in hexagonal grey tile with a little sparkle complements the wall tiles to dado height with gold trim. A gable window takes care of natural light and ventilation.
Stairs and Landing (14.76ft x 5.91ft) The staircase is stained in natural wood effect and leads to the bedroom level. The half return with feature light fitting passes the void looking back down to the entrance all. The landing window floods all levels with natural light. The landing is finished with wood laminate floor.
Main Bedroom (12.80ft x 12.80ft) Located to the front of the property with extensive window this is a lovely double bedroom. Finished with wood laminate floor the room is spacious and allows the occupier to twist and turn the furniture to whatever layout appeals.
En-suite (6.23ft x 4.92ft) Fitted with three-piece white shower suite from the RAK ceramic range with Sonas attachments, the en-suite is fully tiled with an extra-large square floor tile and a funky wall tile. The enclosed shower cubicle is fitted with dual shower head (fixed overhead rain style head and smaller detachable hand-held wand), glazed shower screen fitted. Wall mounted sink unit and close couple wc with soft closing complete the suite. A Velux window takes care of natural light and ventilation.
Bedroom 2 (14.76ft x 8.86ft) Another fine double bedroom with CullenView wall to wall storage to include open shelving, vanity/dressing table and double robes. Finished with wood laminate floor this room is lovely and bright.
Bedroom 3 (15.75ft x 10.83ft) The wood laminate floor seen in the landing is carried through to Bedroom 2, a bright spacious bedroom located to the rear of the property. This room is finished in neutral tones and has extensive fitted robes by CullenView to take care of all storage needs.
Family Bathroom (8.89ft x 5.91ft) Fitted with three-piece white suite from the RAK ceramic range with Sonas attachments, the bathroom is fully tiled with hexagonal black tiled floor contrasting well with the white suite and the white wall tiles. The suite includes bath tub with dual shower head (fixed overhead rain style head and smaller detachable hand-held wand), glazed shower screen fitted. Wall mounted sink unit with under storage and circular vanity mirror complete with gold trim and inbuilt light. Close couple wc with soft closing. Fitted bathroom attachments and complimenting open shelving.

Superb 3 bed home extending to 1,525 sq. ft. (141.72 sq. mt.)
A2 energy rating 
Air to water heat pump 
5 year Home Bond remains 
Quality fittings to include kitchen, utility, bathrooms, robes and tiling 
Spacious bright accommodation throughout
